# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `faceless` MCP server pointing at Faceless's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://faceless.so/api/v1/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Faceless sign-in; an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` also works.
- Logo: Faceless mark from the official `Side-Products/faceless-cursor-plugin` repository.
